notes.title: “Cling to the traditions we taught you”
notes.intro: Paul tells believers to keep the teachings passed on “whether by speech or by letter.”

views.label: Oral Tradition alongside written Scripture
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see here authority for apostolic Tradition handed down alongside Scripture.

views.label: The apostles’ teaching, now found in Scripture
views.summary: Protestants hold that the apostolic teaching Paul refers to is preserved in the New Testament, which is the final authority.
